Lectures

Learn more about our courses

Computer Vision

The goal of this course is to provide students with a good understanding of computer vision and image analysis techniques. The main concepts and techniques will be studied in depth and practical algorithms and approaches will be discussed and explored through the exercises and a course project.

Learn More

Mixed Reality

263-5905-00L

The goal of this course is an introduction and hands-on experience on latest mixed reality technology at the cross-section of 3D computer graphics and vision, human machine interaction, as well as gaming technology.

Learn More

Visual Computing

252-0206-00L

This course acquaints students with core knowledge in computer graphics, image processing, multimedia and computer vision. Topics include: Graphics pipeline, perception and camera models, transformation, shading, global illumination, texturing, sampling, filtering, image representations, image and video compression, edge detection and optical flow.

Learn More

3D Vision

264-5905-00L

The goal of this course is an introduction and hands-on experience on latest mixed reality technology at the cross-section of 3D computer graphics and vision, human machine interaction, as well as gaming technology.

Learn More

Seminar: Deep Learning for Computer Vision

The course covers camera models and calibration, feature tracking and matching, camera motion estimation via simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) and visual inertial odometry (VIO), epipolar and mult-view geometry, structure-from-motion, (multi-view) stereo, augmented reality, and image-based (re-)localization.

Learn More

Doctoral Seminar in Visual Computing

264-5800-22L

In this doctoral seminar, current research at the Institute for Visual Computing will be presented and discussed. The goal is to learn about current research projects at our institute, to strengthen our expertise in the field, to provide a platform where research challenges can be discussed, and also to practice scientific presentations.

Learn More

Seminar in Advanced Topics in Vision

252-5701-00L

This seminar covers advanced topics in computer vision, such as 3D reconstruction, image understanding, object detection, people tracking, motion prediction, and other related topics. Each time the course is offered, a collection of research papers is selected and each student presents one paper to the class and leads a discussion about the paper and related topics.

Learn More

Machine Perception

263-3710-00L

Recent developments in neural networks have drastically advanced the performance of machine perception systems in a variety of areas including computer vision, robotics, and human shape modeling. This course is a deep dive into deep learning algorithms and architectures with applications to a variety of perceptual and generative tasks.

Learn More

Advanced Topics in Embodied Intelligence

263-5908-00L

This seminar provides an overview of techniques in the field of embodied intelligence. It aims to provide an overview of techniques in embodied intelligence, including perception, sensing, language and planning, and how these disciplines are integrated to build embodied intelligence.

Learn More

Robot Learning: From Fundamentals to Foundation Models

263-5911-00L

This course provides a comprehensive introduction to robot learning, covering fundamental concepts, algorithms, and recent advancements in the field. Topics include reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and the integration of foundation models into robotic systems.

Learn More
